subject: S14 reopened: review14 CHANGES REQUESTED (20261117T092823-review14-0fb6e6)
body: (1) BLOCKER: student tokens must never be able to send command.goto/update on runs or POST/PATCH /threads/{id}/state. In the Aegra auth handler, deny state writes and commands from clients (allow only plain input messages and interrupt resumes the graph itself issued), and keep all guard-relevant state (exam_active, question_revealed, disclaimer_shown, intent, memories) server-derived and re-checked inside the graph on every run. Add tests for each forged path against the real host. (2) HIGH: render the disclaimer and final citations after tool-using answers (merged-id bug), with an e2e test. Fix the 3 lows and the nit too.
